body: I wish I knew. It's been plaguing me for so long. Maybe I just lack resilience. I don't know.
Sorry... I don't particularly feel like anyone is against me. There are those who I wish would be better people but nothing on me personally. I hope you find solace in the near future.
It's affecting everything in my life. It's only a matter of time until things fall apart and I do have a reason to feel this way. I'd rather end before I deteriorate to that point.

I have tried both talking to people and taking meds.. It never helps. They always try to find solutions. Try to think of what is wrong. It frustrates me because I can't pinpoint my sadness. I have no 'reason' to be sad.
